name: Monogram Masjid
summary: A bold lowercase m becomes a mosque: two generous arches form the letter, while a taller first stem rises as a minaret.
why: The mark starts with the Latin m of mosque and masjid. Heavy rounded arches make the letter recognizable; the taller first stem and coral cap create a distinct minaret above the hall. The near-black and coral palette keeps the identity direct and contemporary.
risk: The letter is deliberately the first reading. Without the app name, some viewers may see a typographic brand before recognizing a mosque.
reasonToChoose: You want a memorable lettermark with a mosque built into its shape.
